The 8 RAW notes above describe what `tubuild create` produced. That output was NOT used: at 36 members the generated preamble is unusable, so the merged source was hand-assembled from the 36 shards plus src/d_a_gmch.c in ROM-ascending order. Read the file's own header comment for what was and was not reconciled.

MEASURED, and it is the one thing in this TU that is not a shard's own spelling: `#include "common.h"` sits BEFORE daGmch_c.h. common.h and math/Matrix.h both define Matrix4x3 under the single MATRIX4X3_DEFINED guard and whichever is seen first stands. daGmch_c.h reaches math/Matrix.h through dExtSimpleModel_c.h, so without that line ordinal 34 (_ZN8daGmch_c13InitResourcesEv) sees the structured Matrix3x3+Vector3 spelling, splits `mMatrix = IDENTITY_MATRIX4X3` into a 9-word ldm/stm plus a CSE tail and comes out 0x1f0 against the cartridge's 0x1d4 -- 35/36. The shards reached the flat s32[12] spelling through decl_common.h -> common.h; this include replaces that route and restores 36/36.

decl_common.h is deliberately NOT included. It declares 7 of this TU's 26 auto-named members and 3 of those 7 contradict the byte-matched definitions: func_ov081_02126950 as (void*, void*) against (int*, void*), func_ov081_02127708 as int(char*) against void(C*), and func_ov081_0212777c as (void*, int) against (char*, int). Including it would be three `illegal function overloading` errors pointed at the definitions rather than at the header, which is the ov002/Player and ov006/dScMgLuigi_c precedent.

Static-initializer fold: src/unnamed/ov081/__sinit_ov081_021284f0.c is retired; its five file handles (model 0x2fd, animations 0x300/0x301/0x2fe/0x2ff in construction order), six registration nodes, eighteen PMF literals, the nine {enter, update} state pairs at 0x02128f40 and the draw-offset Vector3 at 0x02128ef8 are now defined in this TU, whose delinks claim widens to .init/.ctor/.data/.bss. The offset stays a real Vector3: brace init is constant initialization -- .data image, no .init action, no registration -- so a one-slot GmchDrawReg sentinel's ctor emits the three stores and the declared-ahead Vector3 earns only the registration, whose reference lands on _ZN7Vector3D1Ev directly (this TU's own vague-linkage copy is the pre-existing deadstrip-duplicate). The sentinel's 1-byte bss is a homeless deadstrip. EnterState1 is the table's lone void-returning half and is cast to the int StatePmf. The handwritten source's credit (tangosdev) carries in attribution.json as a path#symbol override on __sinit_d_a_gmch.cpp. Emitted temps need no defined_symbol_renames on this base (@1070-@1074/@1110 nodes, @1076-@1080 literals are all unused).
